intent.name: AuthorizePerCardExecutionEvidenceAlpha10
intent.objective: Bind every verified sequence-card exercise to bounded, tamper-evident, privacy-preserving execution evidence without expanding ARIA authority.
assumptions: alpha.9 is the clean remotely attested baseline
the explicit user instruction Do it approves this bounded evolution

ambiguities.question: Does the runtime receipt claim the complete repository suite ran for this execution, or identify the card admission test contract?
Must wall-clock timestamps repeat across executions, or be exactly bound observations inside deterministic receipt canonicalization?

interpretation.understoodObjective: Derive one independently verifiable receipt from each verified Map, Filter, or Reduce terminal event, join exact program and governance identities, preserve privacy, and keep evidence observational.
assumptions: alpha.9 is the clean remotely attested baseline
the explicit user instruction Do it approves this bounded evolution

ambiguityResolutions.resolution: Bind the canonical card admission test contract only; document that current release and CI health are separate closure evidence.
Treat wall-clock time as an exact observation; deterministic identity means identical evidence inputs canonicalize identically, not that separate runs share a timestamp.

challengeResolutions.resolution: Encode observational class, grantsAuthority false, and an empty capability list; reject any drift.
Derive outcome from the verified terminal Event Spine state, derive identities from the decoded container and policy bytes, and expose only aggregate counts plus an allowlisted SignalSubset.

issues.message: A sealed execution receipt could be misread as permission to execute again or as universal correctness.
The runtime must not accept an operation-supplied success assertion or sensitive payload as evidence.
